name: social-links-extension
description: Right-click open, copy and add your social links on any website. Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari.

scripts.test: node build.mjs && node --test tests/unit.test.mjs tests/regressions.test.mjs tests/firefox-sim.test.mjs tests/sync.test.mjs tests/omnibox.test.mjs tests/popup-features.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node build.mjs && node tests/e2e.cjs && node tests/e2e-paste.cjs && node tests/e2e-omnibox.cjs && node tests/e2e-popup.cjs
scripts.test:popup: node build.mjs && node --test tests/popup-features.test.mjs && node tests/e2e-popup.cjs
scripts.release: node build.mjs && npx web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
